A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Work proceeds by converting mixed numbers to improper fractions with the same denominator (without needing an LCD step)

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they are expressed with the same denominator (including subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs fraction subtraction with like denominators (e.g., (a−b)/d)
Solution subtracts after converting to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed with no fractional subtraction shown
Only simplification/reduction is performed without a subtraction step

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract quantities involving whole and fractional parts by separating/combining parts or by converting mixed numbers to improper fractions.
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately and then combines
Solution converts mixed numbers to improper fractions to perform subtraction
Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Both numbers are simple fractions and no whole-part handling is needed
Only fraction subtraction is shown with no mixed/whole-number structure involved

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow when a fractional part becomes negative and simplify the final result by reducing fractions and/or converting to an integer or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to fractional units (e.g., 1 = d/d) to fix a negative fraction part
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms (including simplifying 0/d to 0)
Solution converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number or integer as the final form
exclusion_criteria: No borrowing/regrouping occurs and no simplification/conversion is performed
Only finding a common denominator or performing subtraction is shown without any regrouping or simplification

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least/common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM or otherwise changes denominators before subtracting
Converts fractions like a/b to an equivalent form with a new denominator (e.g., 5/6 to 15/18)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no denominator change is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without changing to a different denominator

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions (including like-denominator subtraction after any needed conversion).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators
Performs the fraction subtraction portion of a mixed-number subtraction (e.g., 3/5 − 2/5)
Subtracts to get 0/k or a negative fraction result
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts whole-number parts without any fraction subtraction
Only simplifies a fraction after subtraction is already complete

skills.name: Regroup/borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part (or rewriting a whole number as a mixed number) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative.
inclusion_criteria: Fractional part subtraction becomes negative and the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
Rewrites a whole number as (whole−1) plus a full fraction (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3) to subtract a fraction
Adds an equivalent 1 (e.g., 12/12, 5/5) to the fractional part after borrowing
exclusion_criteria: Negative fractional result is handled by combining with whole parts without borrowing (e.g., 2 + (−1) = 1)
Only converts mixed numbers to improper fractions without any borrowing/regrouping step

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the final numeric result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as an integer, proper/improper fraction, or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Simplifies/reduces a fraction (e.g., 9/12 to 3/4; 4/10 to 2/5)
Converts 0/k to 0 or otherwise expresses an integer result
Combines whole and fractional parts into a mixed number or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number
exclusion_criteria: Only performs the subtraction steps without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finds an LCD or rewrites equivalent fractions without simplifying the final answer

inclusion_criteria: Solution performs (a−b)/d after establishing like denominators

exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed with no fractional subtraction

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a convenient equivalent form (mixed ↔ improper, or whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part) to enable subtraction and/or final formatting.
inclusion_criteria: Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or vice versa)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3) or as 0/d for fraction-part subtraction
Solution combines whole and fractional parts into a mixed-number (or integer) final form
exclusion_criteria: Only borrowing/regrouping is done after a negative fraction part appears (tag S04 for that operation)
